inlines.v: EDUL'CORATE, verb transitive [Low Latin edulco, from dulcis, sweet.] 1. To purify; to sweeten. In chimistry, to render substances more mild, by freeing them from acids and salts or other soluble impurities, by washing. 2. To sweeten by adding sugar, syrup, etc.
